notes: Version 0.1.9. Content patch: adds a set of perspective exercise ideas (ellipses and cylinders, cast shadows, reflections, boxes from imagination, foreshortened figure, measuring points, two-point interiors, atmospheric depth, fisheye panorama, and sun shadows) and removes the outdated basic-shapes tag from the Values & Contrast exercise. Also includes the earlier fixes: eliminated constant idle jank by gating the level-up modal animations to only run while visible and making the cursor-glow and streak-shield effect loops idle-aware, plus fixed a startup error that could skip initial UI refresh; fixes the timer preset buttons' lower hit area (timer display overlapped them) and removes their inconsistent hover border. Includes the earlier UI polish: Notes pagination, aligned scroll fades, consistent 8px spacing, balanced 16px spacing around the timer session indicator, restyled preset/gear/pager controls, refined disabled timer-button styling, and a subtler click-shrink effect.
